sous_titre: Chiffre d'affaires trimestriel, en Mds $, du 1er trimestre 2025 au 1er trimestre 2026

T1 2025.texte: The worldwide Ethernet switch market recorded $11,7-billion in revenue in the first quarter of 2025 (1Q25)

T2 2025.texte: The worldwide Ethernet switch market recorded $14.5 billion in revenue in the second quarter of 2025

T3 2025.texte: The worldwide Ethernet switch market recorded $14.7 billion in revenue in the third quarter of 2025 (3Q25)

T4 2025.texte: The total Ethernet switch market, inclusive of both datacenter and non-datacenter segments, grew 35.1% YoY to reach $16.2B in 4Q25
